note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described in the original; the asterisked head length and width measurements are quoted in that work from the 1917 original description or estimated from figures; synonymic lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, paler around the antennal sockets; antennae dark brown; rest of the body pale brown. Head with a few short setae; abdominal tergites with minute short setae. Body length 4.20 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, slightly constricted behind the antennae (1.80–1.90 mm including the rostrum, 1.10 mm excluding the rostrum, maximum width 1.10–1.28 mm); in lateral view strongly concave behind the rostrum, with a weak swelling. Rostrum conical, 0.60 mm long, its anterior part raised. Antennae 13-segmented; 3rd segment twice the length of the 2nd; 4th longer than the 2nd. Mandibles reduced, each with a distinct lateral spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin without notch; maximum width 0.65 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head dark brown; antennae paler; thorax pale brown; abdominal tergites grey-brown, sternites paler. Head with scattered setae; abdominal tergites with scattered short setae. Body length 5.00–5.70 mm. Head capsule subcircular (1.10 mm to the mandibular base, maximum width 1.22–1.40 mm); frontal suture distinct. Frontal plate small, oval. Antennae 14-segmented; 3rd segment longer than the 2nd, 4th subequal in length to the 2nd. Postclypeus pilose, inflated, length less than half its width (0.20 mm long, 0.68 mm wide). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin notched (0.72–0.95 mm wide).
